seg.notes: Basis: Q4 earnings release Table D twelve-month column (cross-checked to 10-K segment note). Segments Aggregates, Concrete, Asphalt mix, Cement (Cement includes calcium products; calc_* null). agg_tons = total incl. internal tons. agg_price = freight-adjusted ASP incl. internal sales. Intersegment '-' shown as 0.0. seg_sales_total / interseg_total computed as sums of published segment lines. Total revenues = net sales + delivery revenues. cem_tons/cem_price are extra fields. Concrete intersegment sales were $6 thousand (shows as -0.0). Aggregates cash gross profit not published in the FY2010 release (null). Other DDA = 'Corporate and other unallocated'. FY2010 was the first year Asphalt mix and Concrete were reported as separate segments.

ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation starts from net earnings, adds income taxes (continuing ops), interest expense net, and REMOVES (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (shown in ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added), then adds DDA&A. Hence ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops; the check passes once that line is included. FY2010 release published EBITDA ($370.6m) and cash earnings ($227.7m) only; no Adjusted EBITDA (adj_ebitda_pub and adj_items null). Release narrative: results include a net pretax expense of $22m (Illinois DOT/Lower Illinois lawsuit settlement charge $40.0m, gain on sale of non-strategic rural Virginia assets, and other Q4 adjustments/charges incl. ~$10m impairment of non-core assets and settlement of prior obligations; SAG included ~$24m of donated real estate, severance and legal items). The FY2011 release later showed 2010 Adjusted EBITDA = EBITDA = $370.6m. No adjusted EPS published.
